text:
leo: Kickoff: POC for customer moving off RivalAI. They want minimal code changes; biggest asks are prompt parity, structured-response compatibility, and predictable billing. Can we run a quick A/B on their top 50 prompts and a focused legal/regulatory regression set?

maria: I can own the parity run. Need their prompt list + example RivalAI requests (headers, params). Do they use streaming or just single response?

leo: They mostly call non-streamed endpoints. Rival payload shows: `model=rival-max`, `max_tokens`, `stop`, `response_format=JSON`. They also sometimes use `nucleus_sampling`.

maria: Mapping notes: Redwood supports structured outputs via content_format or function outputs. Quick curl mapping: `rival:model=rival-max -> redwood:model=redwood-large-v1`, `response_format=JSON -> content_format=structured_json`. I'll create a normalization script to compare outputs.

```bash
# sample mapping for presales
# rival: model=rival-max -> redwood: redwood-large-v1
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","prompt":"...","max_tokens":400,"content_format":"structured_json"}'
```

tim: I'll provision a 2xA10 sandbox for throughput tests (sandbox-sd-04). Opening egress for their test IPs (provided). ETA tomorrow morning.

anya: Sales asked for cost at 500M tokens/month. I'll model two scenarios: hosted usage (mixed model: 80% large / 20% mid) and Dedicated (reserved 1 pod + overage). Will include effects of batching and KV-caching on unit cost.

leo: Also capture response delta on edge-case legal prompts and hallucination/regression rate. We need a small eval harness.

security-bot: Security checklist: Received initial questionnaire. Missing: encryption-at-rest docs, KMS integration diagram, SOC2 scoping confirmation. Upload endpoint: https://redwood.example.com/secqna/acme-co.

rachel-legal: If customer insists on vendor indemnity for hallucination, we need legal signoff. Also confirm retention/deletion SLAs; don't promise more than our default.

maria: Proposed presales plan: (1) 50-prompt parity smoke + token delta report, (2) 200 prompt regression for legal set, (3) cost scenarios hosted vs Dedicated, (4) security answers + SOC2 scope doc. Can we get prompts + security Q by EOD?

leo: I'll chase buyer for artifacts. @tim can you DM sandbox creds and open firewall?

tim: Done. Sandbox reserved: sandbox-sd-04 (2xA10G). Sent creds via DM and opened 34.82.45.10/11.

anya: I'll drop a spreadsheet with cost scenarios and assumptions in the doc. Will call out batching assumptions and expected token reductions.

maria: I'll run deterministic-seed tests to compare RivalAI `nucleus_sampling` effects and set sampling params to match variance. Script will output BLEU-like and token diff per prompt.

leo: Great. If we have the smoke results + security summary by Wed, we should stay in the buying window. Will update buyer after the runs. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Reminder: upload security answers within 72h to avoid hold.
